quote: Experiments on three large-scale WMT tasks and two popular text summarization tasks confirm the effectiveness and generalizability of our approaches.

Experimentally, our approaches significantly outperform the Transformer baseline by 1.08, 1.08, and 1.27 BLEU points on WMT 2014 English‑German, WMT 2014 English‑French, and WMT 2019 Chinese‑English, respectively. Moreover, our approaches generalize well to the text summarization task and achieve consistently better performance on two popular benchmarks, i.e., CNN/DailyMail and Gigaword.
Experiments on three large-scale WMT translation tasks and two popular text summarization tasks confirm the effectiveness and generalizability of our approaches.
